title: Private Property Rights Protection Act of 2025
summary: Strengthens federal protections against eminent domain abuse by prohibiting the use of federal funds for projects where eminent domain is used for private economic development purposes.
eastTexasImpact: Protects East Texas landowners and ranchers from having their property seized for private development projects, particularly relevant given pipeline and energy infrastructure expansion in the region.
